headline: You are welcome here.
subheadline: Come worship with us, ask questions, find community, and join us in serving our neighbors. All are Welcome.
welcomeHeading: A church rooted in worship and open to everyone
welcomeText: Epiphany is a community of people learning to follow Jesus together. Whether you have been part of the Episcopal Church for years, are returning to church, looking for your first church experience, or are simply curious, you are welcome to join us as you are.
serviceText: Our Sunday service begins at 10:00 AM. Come as you are. Visitors are welcome to participate as much or as little as they are comfortable.
outreachText: Faith takes us beyond Sunday morning. Epiphany supports local neighbors through hands-on outreach, partnerships, and practical care.

sundayService.heading: Sunday Eucharist Service
sundayService.priestBio:
Father Geoffrey Taylor
Father Geoff brings a rich background in music, ministry, and higher education. A graduate of the North Carolina School of the Arts with additional studies at Juilliard in New York City, he worked as a professional musician before moving into arts management and university advancement.
While serving at Emory University, he discerned a call to ordained ministry and earned his Master of Divinity from Candler School of Theology in 2003.

Father Geoff has served parishes in the Dioceses of Atlanta and Upper South Carolina, including as Canon for Congregational Development. He now serves as a bi-vocational priest while also working with Wake Forest University School of Medicine and Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist.

He and his wife live in Winston-Salem with their Jack Russell Terrier. In his free time Fr. Geoff enjoys fly fishing in the North Carolina mountains and reading.

closingHeading: There is a place for you here.
closingText: Visit on Sunday, join us online, or reach out if you have a question before you come.
